what: When you hover over the photo, 8×8 accent-color pixels light up one by one over it in shuffled order over .4s (no in-between values). The moment it is fully covered it switches to the second photo (pixel art · a different shot), then turns off in shuffled order over the same .4s. On release it reverses back to the first photo. On touch devices it switches on each tap
ease: none (duration 0 per cell, stagger each .4/cell count · from random)

options.dur: Seconds to cover and uncover, default .4 — 0 switches instantly

from.where: index.html .tm__photo — the person card photo turns into a pixel image (original pixelated image reveal)

note: Cell color follows the element’s color (default --kf-accent). The original uses touch 'ontouchstart' · maxTouchPoints · pointer: coarse are screened and switched to press — parts are split by fx-core’s hover being false
